## Summary
Ayodele Ayoola is a Software Developer based in London, UK, with over 6 years of professional experience building high-performance web, mobile, and full-stack applications. He holds a First Class Honours degree in Computer Science from Middlesex University London (2025) and an Advanced Diploma in Software Engineering with Distinction from Aptech Computer Education (2022).
